standard: IEEE/ISO Industrial Sensor Data Quality Specification
missingDataHandlingRule: CRITICAL: Missing telemetry MUST NEVER be set to zero. Zero flow, zero TMP, or zero MLSS distorts mass balances and generates invalid alarms. Missing values must be flagged DQ_MISSING with configured fallback policy.

flags.description: Sensor value verified valid, in physical range, live dynamic variation present
flags.treatment: Directly fed into Excel formulas and Python digital twin

flags.description: Sensor value suspect: high noise, slight drift relative to redundant peer, or operating near warning threshold
flags.treatment: Accepted with reduced analytical weight; flagged on operator dashboard

flags.description: Sensor out of electrical 4-20mA range, open wire, short circuit, or physically impossible value (e.g., negative absolute pressure, water temp > 50°C)
flags.treatment: Excluded from calculations; triggers sensor diagnostic alarm

flags.description: Telemetry packet dropped or SCADA communication timeout; no value received
flags.treatment: Formula outputs #N/A or uses explicit imputation policy; NEVER imputed as 0.0

flags.description: Sensor output remains exactly identical (variance = 0) over >60 consecutive samples during active pumping
flags.treatment: Identifies frozen transmitter diaphragm or PLC latch; excluded from rate-of-change formulas

flags.description: Reading deviates by > 3 standard deviations or Hampel filter threshold from rolling median
flags.treatment: Replaced by rolling median for robust statistics; raw point preserved in audit log

flags.description: Value derived from soft sensor, peer train surrogate, or linear interpolation
flags.treatment: Permitted for secondary trends; marked clearly as soft-estimate

flags.description: Calculated parameter derived from 100% good input signals
